name: Happy Valley Kids Play Centre
address: 9 Extention St, Pacaltsdorp, George, 6534, South Africa
description_short: Family-friendly play centre in Pacaltsdorp with a restaurant where kids burn energy while parents relax.
description_long:
Happy Valley Kids Play Centre in Pacaltsdorp offers George families a welcome break from the usual restaurant routine. The sprawling indoor and outdoor play areas keep children entertained for hours, from climbing frames to jumping castles, while parents enjoy a meal and conversation at their own pace.

The restaurant serves straightforward family fare—think burgers, pizzas, and platters—designed to please kids and adults alike without breaking the bank. It's not haute cuisine, but portions are generous and the relaxed atmosphere means no one minds a bit of noise or excitement. The outdoor seating overlooks the play areas, so you can keep an eye on the action while enjoying your coffee.

Located just off the main road in Pacaltsdorp, Happy Valley has become a go-to spot for birthday parties, playdates, and weekend outings when the weather turns. The combination of active play and casual dining makes it particularly popular with parents who need their little ones properly tired out before the drive home.
